resources.string: Spoken progress in Chinese, shared by the UI, ASR and A2A; loaded with each request when on.
Finds and orchestrates tools by what they can do now, orders their dependencies and checks the user\'s constraints; works in any domain.
Loaded to plan a trip of several days: three subagents look up transport, stays and each day\'s places, summed up in a trip card grouped by day with photos, then it asks whether to set reminders.
Loaded with each request while an A2A delegate is on: what to hand to the user\'s own agent, confirming first what can\'t be undone, and passing on delegation reports from the background.
Loaded with each request while screen control is connected: domain tools first, one action per step, check the result, confirm irreversible actions first.
Back to the head unit, the Virtual home or the navigation screen: how to use playground_open, and what to do when a dialog is in the way or the Playground isn\'t installed.
